BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.

3. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.

4. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.

5. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

6. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

8. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

11. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

13. When learning Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.

14. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.

15. When learning Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing.

16. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Isometric Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Concreting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Foundations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
